detailed_assertion_map.summary: SEC-CEDAR-01 — Allow plus runtime diagnostic must fail closed at compiled engine.
SEC-CEDAR-02 — Field and row helper must not discard evaluation errors.
SEC-LIVE-01 — Exact Company must participate in actual message fanout.
SEC-EVENT-01 — Public telemetry input must use registered values, not syntax-only private labels.
SEC-EVENT-02 — Real DbError/request-context conversion cannot log private diagnostics publicly.
SEC-EGRESS-01 — Actual configured HTTP client must not follow redirects.
SEC-CONTEXT-01 — bind_active_context at existing request-context/auth application boundary.
SEC-PROJECTION-01 — project_authorized_result at owning application projection.

SEC-PROJECTION-02: execute once, retain original receipt, then revoke a field/resource grant and replay same command ID. Business effect count remains1; returned outcome is only currently authorized projection, possibly denied/unavailable. No second effect or unconditional historical payload disclosure. Positive unrevoked replay confirms receipt continuity. Optional gate/review routes must not disclose global coverage to a scoped reviewer.

SEC-PROJECTION-03: CONTROL_REFERENCE15minute exact typed handle bound to Account/session/context,Company-or-Group/action/field/schema/expiry. Cross-binding replay or expired handle fails before any effect and preserves permissible user input; fresh authorized render succeeds. A raw private reference in public form must not substitute for handle. Do not require global-cycle equality for scoped basis card.
SEC-EVENT-03 — build_safe_operational_event at existing telemetry/tracing boundary.
SEC-EGRESS-02 — admit_bound_egress at storage/notification transport boundary.

VERUS-01 source binding: preserve original supplied-value proof. For each actual new function bind source Git blob, exact executable body/struct-field identity, feature/toolchain/compiler/Verus/Z3 pins. Ghost views may describe source data but cannot replace projection body with a toy model. Any rename needs mechanical mapping to OR28D four functions and all callers. List actual assume/external_body/unsafe/FFI and refine each external loading/output relation; no assumption that allowed=true or adapter outputs match across private worlds.

VERUS-02 relational predicates: define low_equivalent(context,policy,public_environment,state_left,state_right,allowed_releases). Cross-Group private-state variation and separately same-Company hidden-field variation. Logical observe includes status/headers/body/length, SSR/hydration, cache-visible output, stream count/order/topic/content, public event schedule and egress destination/projected payload. Integrity property compares untouched B-owned state after an A command. Couple public randomness/clock where specified; exclude real timing/traffic/shared-resource and ciphertext equality explicitly. Current ActiveContext exact equality is distinct from minimum freshness predicate.

VERUS-03 nonvacuity/mutations: valid A value actually emitted, valid B operation actually changes B, hidden value omitted; independently mutate wrong Company acceptance, missing field redaction, extra secret-dependent safe log event, and unbound egress. Each breaks the designated source-bound proof or actual boundary test. Import/parse/toolchain failure is not proof rejection. Report verified units/failed obligations separately from runtime tests and source-discovered fixtures.

VERUS-04 actual sink enrollment: for each source-sink-map row record route/job caller, owner loader, projector/error policy, concrete serializer/emitter/client, current-context recheck, actual test and remaining external assumption. ADAPT requires working binding; UNAVAILABLE_FIRST_SLICE/ADAPT_OR_DISABLE requires exercised fail-closed route or non-enrollment. Grep and compile-private types help locate bypasses but cannot close SQL operand loading, dynamic route alias, external logging or process credential boundaries.

CTX-01 authorized populated pagination: seed32Group/256Company bounded maximum via actual topology, Account grant and context-source owners. Distinct permitted labels, one permitted context identity with denied label, and one undiscoverable context; query GET /api/v2/accounts/me/contexts?page_size=1. Exact collected context_ref set equals independently authorized fixture set once each; no hidden item/count/label or denied-derived sort key. Omitted label still has entry_ref:{kind:WORKSPACE}; no CompanyActor rows created by reads. Positive membership/grant source rows must be read back before query. This is not achievable by inserting fabricated candidates alone.

CTX-02 current authority and temporal cursor: after page1, revoke a previously allowed context or make a previously denied candidate allowed through actual policy owner; increment proper source/context generations in same transaction. Old cursor409 stale_cursor, no hidden ownership distinction; fresh whole scan reflects authorized change. Use a fixed clock/boundary around earliest whole-scan temporal transition to catch denied->allowed candidates not in page1. Expired cursor at5minutes, foreign Account cursor, changed query and unexpected-future generation all refuse. unavailable authority503 navigation_unavailable; empty successful scope200 contexts:[] without next_cursor. These precise cases remain catalog/owner-prerequisite blocked until populated discovery exists.

CTX-03 keys across replicas: BW31 single-key issuer/public fingerprint exact at startup. Two app replicas with distinct fixture keys and same DB cannot both report admitted Account service; mixed-key readiness fails. Stop/drain/revoke Account families, replace all keys and restart; old access/refresh/CSRF invalid, fresh primary login works, original identity and historical terms remain. The existing csrf_wrong_key test validates request signatures only; it does not witness startup homogeneity, drain or rollback. No key-rollover implementation is assumed.

PUB-01 external operator custody: BW31 contract12 publication, not user endpoint. Proposed actual publisher call/CLI must resolve a local immutable TermsPublicationApproval in admitted deployment custody, authenticate approved_by and independently qualified content_authority_refs, validate exact manifest/artifact digests, then mutate. Supply identical JSON/hash via an untrusted app request/path; refuse before any receipt/head change. Missing/unreadable custody artifact, unknown operator or missing qualified content reference also refuse; snapshot head+receipts exact. Trusted TEST_ONLY fixture may be used only with explicit test environment; production mode rejects TEST_ONLY. A syntactically correct approval hash alone is never the positive control.

PUB-02 tuple/CAS: with head revision7, valid actual custody approval expected7/next8 and exact digest M yields one immutable receipt(id,previous_revision7,revision8,manifestM,exact approval bytes) and head(8,M,same receipt). Two concurrent publishers with expected7: exactly one succeeds, loser reports current conflict without second receipt or head mutation. Same manifest bytes republished get a new revision/receipt; A->B->A cannot revive old registration. Genesis1 from absent head is separately admitted; max signed bigint fails closed without wrap.

PUB-03 atomicity: trigger a real insert/commit failure in disposable DB after approval validation but before publication transaction commits; both receipt and head remain old. Exact response loss/retry behavior must be specified by actual publisher registration before choosing idempotency oracle; do not invent replay semantics absent approval. Independent receipt/head readback after success required.

PUB-04 custody integrity: immutable manifest1..8 required distinct kinds, each digest resolves exact registered UTF-8 content <=64KiB and wrapper<=16KiB. Alter one content byte, alias digest/path, duplicate kind, unknown kind, unsupported locale/title shape, symlink/path escape or unavailable registered content; actual publisher refuses without mutation. Existing HTTP artifact reads prove serving behavior, not custody publication approval.

PUB-05 publication vs finish locks: actual registration holds account_security then head FOR SHARE while successful finish commits. Pause through a witnessed lock; publisher head update waits until consent commits with exact old tuple, or publisher wins and finish rejects terms_changed with no partial activation. Assert pg_locks/blocker identity and correlated receipt/head/acceptance/security event after release. FOR KEY SHARE is a targeted negative mutation because a non-key digest/revision UPDATE could pass. Do not count a timeout as contention evidence or directly update head in place of actual publisher.

PUB-06 privileges: console_rt and company command LOGIN cannot modify head/receipt via table/column grants, default grants, role membership, PUBLIC or callable SECURITY DEFINER bypass. Authorized Account publisher role can perform only admitted operation; auth readers can load current/retained authority but not publish. Inspect effective privileges plus actual denied statements and successful publisher positive. Role name/ACL existence alone insufficient. Head lock must not take locks on all Accounts.

PUB-07 rollback/mixed release: restore old artifact configuration while DB head newer; enrollment503 authority_unavailable, existing independently eligible Account operations remain safe; no stale acceptance/default head. New binary missing a retained accepted digest must not delete historical acceptance or invent a release receipt. Production publisher/qualified content custody remains separate authority HOLD even when these synthetic operator tests pass.
